description: Replace ALL existing redirects on a WordPress site with redirects for this project's non-published pages. Published pages serve at their original URLs; non-published ones 301 to the homepage (or `redirect_to`). Destructive — wipes any prior redirect state on the site. Plugin mode only. Before calling, ensure system pages are either published or excluded so they don't 301.

redirect_to.description: Custom redirect target URL (default: homepage). Example: "https://example.com/new-landing/"

name: push_redirects_replace_all
